# NEW 2026-11-22 v11.5 Worker 2: The Indian Ocean and the Subcontinent (oe_ind_, Slot 91, 0 vanilla overrides). Generated by gen_v115_india.py; edit the generator, not this file.

# Slot 91 entry: scheduler host scope, once a quarter. Only world-level state lives here; the countries
# of the theatre are checked by their own quarterly pulse (on_action/oe_ind_pulse.txt).
oe_ind_monthly = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_ran_m value = oe_ml_month_now }
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind_init } }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_init value = 1 }
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_pulse_count value = 0 }
	}
	change_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_pulse_count add = 1 }
	if = {
		limit = {
			current_year >= 1509
			has_global_variable = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active
			NOT = { has_global_variable = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active }
			NOT = { oe_rule_is_global_arcs_player_only = yes }
		}
		set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active value = 1 }
	}
}

# Country scope: a protagonist's quarterly check.
oe_ind_country_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_syn_cd }
			has_industry_promotion = industry_type:oe_ind_indian_ocean_cotton_spices
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_syn_cd years = 15 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ind_cotton_spice_synergy_mod years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
	if = {
		limit = {
			is_ai = yes
			oe_rule_is_global_arcs_full_ai = yes
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ai_cd }
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ai_cd years = 10 }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ind_rival_ai_mod years = 10 mode = replace }
	}
	oe_ind_story_tick = yes
}

# Country scope: fires at most one story event whose condition holds.
oe_ind_story_tick = {
	if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev2_done }
			current_year >= 1400
			tag = VIJ
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev2_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.2
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev4_done }
			current_year >= 1450
			owns = location:bidar
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev4_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.4
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev5_done }
			current_year >= 1400
			owns = location:raichur
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev5_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.5
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev6_done }
			has_ports = yes
			OR = {
				has_global_variable = oe_weu2_por_cartaz_active
				current_year >= 1498
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev6_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.6
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev8_done }
			current_year >= 1500
			has_advance = oe_ind_adv_tulughma_field_artillery
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev8_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.8
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev9_done }
			oe_ind_has_mansabdari_levies = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev9_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.9
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev12_done }
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:hindu
			owns = location:srirangam
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev12_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.12
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev13_done }
			OR = {
				owns = location:bhopal
				owns = location:gaya
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev13_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.13
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev14_done }
			has_advance = oe_ind_adv_deccan_rocket_batteries
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev14_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.14
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev1_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1350
			owns = location:delhi
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev1_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.1
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev3_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1450
			exists = religion
			religion = religion:hindu
			has_ports = yes
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev3_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.3
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev7_done }
			is_ai = yes
			has_ports = yes
			has_global_variable = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev7_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.7
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev10_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1575
			exists = religion
			OR = {
				religion = religion:sunni
				religion = religion:shia
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev10_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.10
	}
	else_if = {
		limit = {
			NOT = { has_variable = oe_ind_ev11_done }
			is_ai = yes
			current_year >= 1600
			OR = {
				owns = location:gaur
				owns = location:sonargaon
				owns = location:surat
				owns = location:khambat
			}
		}
		set_variable = { name = oe_ind_ev11_done value = 1 }
		trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.11
	}
}

# Country scope. Temple economy bonus for Hindu countries that have taken a v9.9 avatar.
oe_ind_apply_temple_avatar_synergy = {
	if = {
		limit = { oe_ind_has_temple_avatar = yes }
		add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ind_v99_avatar_temple_synergy years = 15 mode = replace }
	}
}

# Country scope. The league against the pass system (this worker is the only writer of the global variable).
oe_ind_form_diu_league = {
	set_global_variable = { name = oe_ind_diu_coalition_active value = 1 }
	add_country_modifier = { modifier = oe_ind_diu_league_mod years = 20 mode = replace }
}

# Dev panel: research this theatre's advances.
oe_ind_dev_unlock_all = {
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind_adv_warhorse_monsoon_network } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind_adv_warhorse_monsoon_network
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind_adv_tulughma_field_artillery } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind_adv_tulughma_field_artillery
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind_adv_rupee_grand_trunk } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind_adv_rupee_grand_trunk
	}
	if = {
		limit = { NOT = { has_advance = oe_ind_adv_deccan_rocket_batteries } }
		research_advance = advance_type:oe_ind_adv_deccan_rocket_batteries
	}
}

# Dev panel: run the slot entry and this country's quarterly check now.
oe_ind_dev_force_tick = {
	oe_ind_monthly = yes
	oe_ind_country_tick = yes
}

# Dev panel: readout.
oe_ind_dev_readout = {
	trigger_event_non_silently = oe_ind.90
}
